Blade and Baton.name: Blade and Baton
Blade and Baton.description:
🗡️ You fight with a hand weapon (baton, staff, knife, sword or chain whip), backed by quick, evasive footwork.

🎯 You keep opponents at weapon length, strip their weapons and find the gaps in their guard.
⚠️ You need a weapon in hand or something to improvise with, such as a pipe or an umbrella.
📈 You learn more techniques as your Melee Weapons and Dodging improve.
⚖️ Carrying a knife or sword in public without good reason is a crime, an owned sword must be registered, and a carried baton draws police questions.
🤝 Licensed heroes carry approved support weapons; students use them only in training. Bladed heroes face more press suspicion.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Melee Weapons +15, Dodging +10
⚡ Starting technique: Reach Ward
Blade and Baton.traitNarrativeEffects: Hand weapon (baton, staff, blade or chain) plus evasive footwork: reach keeps foes out of fist and grappling range; strikes hands and joints; slips attacks, never absorbs. At start: handles a small untrained group, matches a trained fighter with a similar weapon. Blunt deals bludgeoning; blades slashing or piercing. Unarmed: footwork and improvised objects (pipe, umbrella, chair leg); every technique needs something held. Thrown weapons are Marksmanship. Pure training: same for Quirkless; techniques cost stamina, never Quirk Strain. Law: a knife or sword carried in public without legitimate reason is a crime in Japan; owned swords must be registered; a baton or staff carried as a weapon draws police questions. Licensed heroes carry approved support weapons; students only in training or supervised hero work. Bladed heroes draw more press suspicion. Look: fast-draw weapon (baton on hip, staff on back, sword case), light shoes, side-on stance, scarred forearms.
